Bangladesh vs Pakistan LIVE Score: Hamza Choudhury starts in BAN v PAK; Real-time updates from SAFF Championship 2026 semifinal; Level at half-time; Bangladesh 0 - 0 Pakistan
 BAN vs PAK LIVE: Catch the real-time updates from the Bangladesh vs Pakistan SAFF Championship 2026 semifinal match being played in Dhaka.
 Updated : Nov 14, 2026 20:50 IST

 Welcome to Sportstar’s live coverage of the Bangladesh vs Pakistan SAFF Championship 2026 semifinal match being played in Dhaka. 
 MATCH OVERVIEW 
 Venue: National Stadium
 Kick-off time: 8:00 p.m. IST (8:30 p.m. local time)
 Pakistan starting lineup: Yousuf Ijaz Butt (GK), Mohib Ullah, Abdullah Iqbal (captain), Easah Suliman, Abdul Samad Shahzad, Muhammad Ali Akbar Khan, Mckeal Aroon, Junaid Ahmed, Ali Uzair, Haris Zeb, Adi Nabi
 Bangladesh starting lineup: Mohammad Mehdi Hasan Srabon (GK), Zidane Yousuf, Tariq Kazi, Zayyan Ahmed, Mohammad Rahmat Mia, Hamza Choudary (C), Shamit Shome, Quazem Kirmanee, Farhaan Ali Wahid, Rakib Hossain, Shukti Itofusa
 November 14, 2026 20:50 
 Half-Time!
 Both teams will need to head into the locker room and figure out a better plan to get ahead in the game. 
They are currently, both, struggling to create impactful chances.
 November 14, 2026 20:48 
 45' - Pakistan's slow attacks
 Pakistan’s midfielders need to move the ball faster to have a chance of putting Bangladesh defenders under pressure.
The side is not showing much imagination so far.
 November 14, 2026 20:43 
 5 more mins in the first half
 This has been a cagey and nervous first half for both sides. The teams look like they don’t want to lose more than they want to win.
However, Pakistan has come the closest to scoring, but Bangladesh has had more possession and the more convincing attacks.
 November 14, 2026 20:37 
 35' - Wahid with the silky moves
 Farhaan Wahid jinks past Pakistan’s left back and cuts into his stronger right foot. Once he reaches near the box, he takes a shot, but it is far off target.
 November 14, 2026 20:35 
 32' - Pakistan hit the post!
 The ball is crossed in from the middle of the pitch, after an excellent touch from Abdullah, he manages a shot that crawls past the keeper.
However, the Bangladeshi keeper did enough to keep the ball from going into the goal and it bounces out for a corner after hitting the post
Bangladesh 0 - 0 Pakistan
 November 14, 2026 20:31 
 29' - Cooling Break
 The teams recharge themselves, but will have to find better ways to get through the opposition’s defence
 November 14, 2026 20:29 
 25' - Bangladesh counter
 Bangladesh 0 - 0 Pakistan
The score looks like it won’t change unless the teams get more clinical in front of the goal and finds the moment of inspiration
 November 14, 2026 20:26 
 22 - Bangladesh corner
 Bangladesh takes a corner, sending deep towards the far post.
Hamza heads it back towards the goal, and the following shot hits the bar. Bangladesh players are in disbelief about the lack of scoringl=.
 November 14, 2026 20:16 
 17' - Hamza is everywhere
 Hamza Choudhury, utilising his English league experience, anchors both the defence and the midfield. Trying to break up attacks and connect other players to the midfield.
 November 14, 2026 20:14 
 12 minutes gone
 Both teams have had shots on target, but nothing too convincing.
The sides seem to be figuring each other out.
Bangladesh 0 - 0 Pakistan
 November 14, 2026 20:11 
 Bangladesh - Shot on target
 Quazem Kirmine takes a shot from outside the box, but it was a comfortable save for Pakistan’s captain.
 November 14, 2026 20:07 
 Hamza shows up
 Hamza Choudhury has made his presence felt with quick passing and physicality to inspire his team to be more on the front foot.
 November 14, 2026 20:05 
 Bangladesh has not settled
 Pakistan is making the most of Bangladesh’s nervous mistakes in the opening minutes. Counter-attacking and pressing high
 November 14, 2026 20:03 
 Pakistan's formation
 Pakistan has chosen to go back to its usual three at the back. 
Instead of a more conservative five at the back
 November 14, 2026 20:02 
 Kick off!
 Bangladesh are kicking left to right
Hamza Choudary commits a foul in the first minute. He might be setting the tone for the physicality to come.
 November 14, 2026 20:00 
 VAR is available
 VAR is going to be at the service of the referees if they require it.
Both teams will hope for no long delays or controversial decisions.
 November 14, 2026 19:59 
 Match begins soon!
 The national anthems are done, and the players are gearing up for a fixture that will be intense and competitive. 
Both teams will want to get an early lead, so they can play pragmatic football.
 November 14, 2026 19:36 
 The winner faces India
 The winner of the match tonight will face India in the finals of the SAFF Championship.
India has reached its 10th final in a row. Both Pakistan and Bangladesh will be hoping to end India’s run
 November 14, 2026 19:28 
 Bangladesh Starting XI
 Mohammad Mehdi Hasan Srabon (GK), Zidane Yousuf, Tariq Kazi, Zayyan Ahmed, Mohammad Rahmat Mia, Hamza Choudary (C), Shamit Shome, Quazem Kirmanee, Farhaan Ali Wahid, Rakib Hossain, Shukti Itofusa
 November 14, 2026 19:23 
 Recent results
 Bangladesh beat Pakistan 1-0 in 2018 in the same competition
While Pakistan beat Bangladesh 2-1 in 2013. 
The two matches before that both ended in a goalless draw
 November 14, 2026 19:22 
 Bangladesh vs Pakistan: Head-to-head
 Both teams have a competitive history. 
In the 17 fixtures between them, Pakistan has won six matches, while Bangladesh has won seven, with four draws in between.
 November 14, 2026 19:16 
 Preview:
 Pakistan takes on Bangladesh in the semifinal of the SAFF Championship 2026. Bangladesh has won both of their matches, beating Bhutan and Sri Lanka. While, Pakistan has won one of the two matches, beating Maldives and losing to India.
Bangladesh is trying to get back to the finals for the first time since 2005. Pakistan on the other hand is hoping to make the finals for the first ever time
 November 14, 2026 18:59 
 Pakistan starting XI
 Yousuf Ijaz Butt (GK), Mohib Ullah, Abdullah Iqbal (captain), Easah Suliman, Abdul Samad Shahzad, Muhammad Ali Akbar Khan, Mckeal Aroon, Junaid Ahmed, Ali Uzair, Haris Zeb, Adi Nabi
 November 14, 2026 18:53

 Welcome, everyone, to the Bangladesh vs Pakistan semifinal in the SAFF Championship 2026.
